headline.text: Steven N'Zonzi's decisive goal secures Blackburn Rovers a narrow 1-0 victory over Manchester United

sentences.text: Blackburn Rovers edged out Manchester United with a solitary goal scored by Steven N'Zonzi at 27:14 on the match clock.
Steven N'Zonzi led the scoring with his single goal, while Paul Scholes, David Dunn, and Mauro Formica each received six passes, highlighting their involvement in play.
David Dunn and Gael Givet topped the recoveries chart with five each, showcasing Blackburn's defensive efforts.
Blackburn Rovers outshot Manchester United 7 to 5 and received 31 passes compared to United's 27, reflecting their slight edge in offensive activity.
They also led in recoveries 23 to 21 and held 51.2% possession, underscoring their overall control in the match.
